plugins.name: excel-vba-cli
plugins.description: Excel automation skill for coding agents: drives real Microsoft Excel via the excelcli CLI (Power Query, DAX, PivotTables, Tables, Ranges, Charts, VBA, screenshots - 31 command groups / 387 operations). Shares sessions with the Excel VBA Assistant VS Code/Trae extension through a single-instance daemon.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 面向编码 agent 的 Excel 自动化技能：通过 excelcli 命令行驱动真实 Excel（Power Query、DAX、透视表、表格、区域、图表、VBA、截图——31 组命令 / 387 操作）。经单实例 daemon 与 Excel VBA Assistant VS Code/Trae 扩展共享会话。
